newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-OFFICIAL BLAMES DEPORTIVO CHIEF FOR THREATS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-OFFICIAL BLAMES DEPORTIVO CHIEF FOR THREATS.

text.p: A member of the committee that ordered Deportivo Coruna to close their ground for the vital league clash with Barcelona has hit out at Deportivo president Augusto Lendoiro after receiving threats.

"I want publicly to make Lendoiro responsible for any damage to me, or members of my family," said Jose Manuel Otero of the Committee for Sporting Discipline "He is the one responsible for having incited the fans to violence and for having put me in their sights as victim,"

Lendoiro had sugggested that fans should ask what part Otero, a local man, had played in the decision to close the Riazor stadium after a match referee was hit in the face by a coin thrown from the stands.
The committee recently decided against closing Sevilla's Sanchez Pizjuan ground after a similar incident.

It is not the first clash between Otero, a former Real Madrid official, and Lendoiro. The Deportivo president once asked reporters whether they thought Otero "would be able to walk peacefullly through his city."
